verses.sloka: स तथोक्तस्तु निर्भर्त्स्य कुम्भकर्णो महोदरम्।अब्रवीद्राक्षसश्रेष्ठं भ्रातरं रावणं ततः ।। ६.६५.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tathoktastu nirbhartsya kumbhakarṇo mahodaram।abravīdrākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ bhrātaraṁ rāvaṇaṁ tataḥ ।। 6.65.1 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna having heard Mahodara, warned him not to speak that way and spoke to Ravana, the foremost of Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: युदकाण्ड का बासठबाँ सग पूरा हुआ । त्रिषष्टितमः सगः तस्य राक्षसराजस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम्‌ ! कुम्भकर्णो बभाष ऽथ वचनं प्रजहास च

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं तव भयं घोरं वधात्तस्य दुरात्मनः।रामस्याद्य प्रमार्जामि निर्वैरो हि सुखी भव ।। ६.६५.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ tava bhayaṁ ghoraṁ vadhāttasya durātmanaḥ।rāmasyādya pramārjāmi nirvairo hi sukhī bhava ।। 6.65.2 ।।

translations.english: "You know me. I will get rid of your enmity killing the cruel minded Rama. Be fearless and happy now."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! प्रथम वार परामर्श करते समय हम लोगों को जो दोष दीख पड़े थे, वे ही अब तुम्हारे सामने आ उपस्थित हुए । क्योकि उस समय तुमने अपने हितैषियों की उन बातों को पसन्द नहीं किआ था

verses.sloka: गर्जन्ति न वृथा शूरा निर्जला इव तोयदाः।पश्य सम्पाद्यमानं तु गर्जितं युधि कर्मणा ।। ६.६५.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: garjanti na vṛthā śūrā nirjalā iva toyadāḥ।paśya sampādyamānaṁ tu garjitaṁ yudhi karmaṇā ।। 6.65.3 ।।

translations.english: "Warriors will not roar wastefully like waterless clouds. You will see me roaring after having completed the action."
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार महापातकियों को शीघ्र नरक में गिरना पड़ता है; उसी प्रकार सीताहरणरूपी पापकर्म का गी फल घ्र गया

verses.sloka: न मर्षयति चात्मानं सम्भावयति नात्मना।अदर्शयित्वा शूरास्तु कर्म कुर्वन्ति दुष्करम् ।। ६.६५.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: na marṣayati cātmānaṁ sambhāvayati nātmanā।adarśayitvā śūrāstu karma kurvanti duṣkaram ।। 6.65.4 ।।

translations.english: "Warriors do not tolerate even when glorified. They never praise themselves. They accomplish difficult deeds without displaying them."

verses.sloka: विक्लवानामबुद्धीनां राज्ञा पण्डितमानिनाम्।शृण्वता सादितमिदं त्वद्विधानां महोदर ।। ६.६५.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: viklavānāmabuddhīnāṁ rājñā paṇḍitamāninām।śṛṇvatā sāditamidaṁ tvadvidhānāṁ mahodara ।। 6.65.5 ।।

translations.english: "O Mahodara! Your words of appeal will be accepted as cowardly, devoid of intellect and to those who do not know anything, it looks as if you know."
translations.hindi: जो ऐश्वर्यबान्‌ राजा प्रथम करने योग्य काय को पीछे और पीछे करने योग्य कार्य को प्रथम करता है, वह नीति अनीति ज्ञानने वाला नहीं कहलाता

verses.sloka: युद्धे कापुरुषैर्नित्यं भवद्भिः प्रियवादिभिः।राजानमनुगच्छद्भिः कृत्यमेतद्धि सादितम् ।। ६.६५.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhe kāpuruṣairnityaṁ bhavadbhiḥ priyavādibhiḥ।rājānamanugacchadbhiḥ kṛtyametaddhi sāditam ।। 6.65.6 ।।

translations.english: "You, who always fear in combat, are talking pleasingly to the king , going after him happily brought the matter to this state."

verses.sloka: राजशेषा कृता लङ्का क्षीणः कोशो बलं हतम्।राजानमिममासाद्य सुहृच्चिह्नममित्रकम् ।। ६.६५.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: rājaśeṣā kṛtā laṅkā kṣīṇaḥ kośo balaṁ hatam।rājānamimamāsādya suhṛccihnamamitrakam ।। 6.65.7 ।।

translations.english: "The king is left alone in Lanka, which is divested of its wealth, and treasury reduced, and the army destroyed by unfriendly people pretending as good friends around him."
translations.hindi: देश और काल का विचार कर जो काम किए जाते हैं, वे समस्त कार्य दूषित होने के कारण विपरीत फल देने वाले होते हैं । अर्थात्‌ वे कार्ये उती प्रकार इष्टफन्नदायी नहीं होते, जिस प्रकार मत्र से संस्कारित न किए हुए अग्नि में डाली हुई आहु- तियाँ इष्टफलदात्री नहीं होतीं ॥ $ ॥ त्रयाणां २पञ्चधा योगं कर्मणां यः प्रपश्यति । ~ Q ८5 सचिब; श्समयं कृत्वा स ४सम्य वर्तते पथि

verses.sloka: एष निर्याम्यहं युद्धमुद्यतः शत्रुनिर्जये।दुर्नयं भवतामद्य समीकर्तुमिहाहवे ।। ६.६५.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa niryāmyahaṁ yuddhamudyataḥ śatrunirjaye।durnayaṁ bhavatāmadya samīkartumihāhave ।। 6.65.8 ।।

translations.english: "I am setting out in this manner to the battlefield, to overpower the enemies in the battle in order to redeem the mistakes done by all of you."
translations.hindi: जो राज्ञा नीतिशाख् का उल्लङ्घन न कर और म त्रियो झे साथ सलाह कर तथा अपने हितैषी मित्रों के खाथ विचार कर, किसी कार्य के करने न करने का निश्चय करता है, वही राज्ञा नीतिबान कहल्लाता हे

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तवतो वाक्यं कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः।प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं प्रहसन् राक्षसाधिपः ।। ६.६५.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktavato vākyaṁ kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ।pratyuvāca tato vākyaṁ prahasan rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 6.65.9 ।।

translations.english: Wise Kumbhakarna having spoken in that way, the Rakshasa king, Ravana laughed and replied in this way.

translations.english: "O dear! You are an expert in war! This Mahodara is terrified at Rama. He is not desiring war. There is no doubt."

translations.english: "O Kumbhakarna! There is none who is equal to you in might and friendliness at heart towards me. You go and be victorious by killing the enemies."

translations.english: "You are difficult to encounter. You have awakened for the sake of putting an end to the enemy. It is a momentous period for the Rakshasas, O tamer of enemies."
translations.hindi: द काले घर्माथकामान्यः सम्मन्त्रय सचिवैः सह । ह निवेवेतात्मवाँच्चोकै न स व्यसनमा“चुपात ह १२ और धर्म, अर्थ, कास सम्बन्धी कार्यों की मंत्रणा मंत्रियों र साथ उचित समय पर जो जितेन्द्रिय राजा किआ करता अको संसार भें कभी दुःख प्रात न्दी होता

verses.transliteration: tadgaccha śūlamādāya pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ।vānarān rājaputrau ca bhakṣayādityatejasau ।। 6.65.13 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, taking up trident holding the noose in hand like the God of Death proceed to devour the monkeys as well as the two princes shining like the Sun."

verses.sloka: समालोक्य तु ते रूपं विद्रविष्यन्ति वानराः।रामलक्ष्मणोश्चापि हृदये प्रस्फुटिष्यतः ।। ६.६५.१४ ।।

verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahārājaḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam।punarjātamivātmānaṁ mene rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ ।। 6.65.15 ।।

translations.english: The highly energetic king of Rakshasas having spoken like that to mighty Kumbhakarna, felt as if he had taken birth again.
translations.hindi: जिस राजा को विपुल राजैश्चयं प्राप्त करने की इच्छा हो, उसे ऐसे नीतिशास्रानभिज्ञ मूखे और अभिप्राय न सममने वाल्ले मंत्रियों की काम को बिगाडने वाली बातों पर कभी ध्यान न दैना चाहिए

translations.english: The king who knew the valour and mighty strength of Kumbhakarna remained happy like the moon.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार पक्तीगण स्वामिकातिक द्वारा विदारित क्रोंच पर्वत के छिद्रों में घुस जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार शत्र, भी झटपट काम में हाथ डालने वाले और बुरे मन्त्रियों की सलाह 'में चलने बाले राजा के ऊपर आक्रमण कर बैठते हैं

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्तः संहृष्टो निर्जगाम महाबलः ।। ६.६५.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktaḥ saṁhṛṣṭo nirjagāma mahābalaḥ ।। 6.65.17 ।।

translations.english: The king having spoken these words, mighty Kumbhakarna, pleased with the king's words set forth to fight.
translations.hindi: जो मंत्री केवल ढिठाई से अहित को हित बना कर कहते हैं वे काम के बिगाड़ने वाले होते हैं, उनको विचारसभा से निकाल देना चाहिये॥ १६.॥ ` विनाशयन्तो भर्तारं सहिताशत्रुमिमु चैः । _ _ विपरीतानि कृत्यानि कारयन्तीह मन्त्रिणः

verses.sloka: राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कुम्भकर्णः समुद्यतः।आददे निशितं शूलं वेगाच्छत्रुनिबर्हणम् ।। ६.६५.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rājñastu vacanaṁ śrutvā kumbhakarṇaḥ samudyataḥ।ādade niśitaṁ śūlaṁ vegācchatrunibarhaṇam ।। 6.65.18 ।।

translations.english: The destroyer of enemies, hurriedly seized a whetted flaming iron dart, embellished with polished gold.
translations.hindi: जो मन्त्री मित्र बन कर मन्त्रणा के समय शत्रु जैसी सम्मति देते हों, राजा को उचित है कि, व्यवहार द्वारा ऐसे घूँसखोर स न्रियों का असली रूप जान कर इनको निकाल दे

verses.sloka: सर्वकालायसं दीप्तं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम्।इन्द्राशनिसमं भीमं वज्रप्रतिमगौरवम् ।। ६.६५.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvakālāyasaṁ dīptaṁ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇam।indrāśanisamaṁ bhīmaṁ vajrapratimagauravam ।। 6.65.19 ।।

translations.english: The dart was like Indra's thunderbolt in form and was equal to thunderbolt, capable of destroying Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yakshas and Pannagas, was like rising fire shining like the face of an enemy. It was sharp, wreathed in garlands of red colour and emitting flame. Kumbhakarna wielding the dart said.

verses.sloka: देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षकिन्नरसूदनम्।रक्तमाल्यं महाधामस्वतश्चोद्गतपावकम् ।। ६.६५.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvayakṣakinnarasūdanam।raktamālyaṁ mahādhāmasvataścodgatapāvakam ।। 6.65.20 ।।

translations.english: The dart was like Indra's thunderbolt in form and was equal to thunderbolt, capable of destroying Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yakshas and Pannagas, was like rising fire shining like the face of an enemy. It was sharp, wreathed in garlands of red colour and emitting flame. Kumbhakarna wielding the dart said.
translations.hindi: जो राजा शत्र, को तुच्छ समझ कर अपनी रक्षा नहीं करता, बह बडे भारी अनर्थे को प्राप्त] कर, स्थानभ्रष्ट भी हो जाता हे

verses.sloka: आदाय निशितं शूलं शत्रुशोणितरञ्जितम्।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजा रावणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६५.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādāya niśitaṁ śūlaṁ śatruśoṇitarañjitam।kumbhakarṇo mahātejā rāvaṇaṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 6.65.21 ।।

translations.english: Enraged and angry Kumbhakarna said, "I will proceed now. Let my army remain here. I will consume them on keys today."
translations.hindi: हे रावण ! तुम्हारी खी मन्दोदरी ने और मेरे छोटे भाई बिभीषण ने पहिले जो सलाह दी थी, वही हम लोगों के लिए अयस्कर थी । जब उसको तुमने नहीं माना; तब अब तुम्हारी जो इच्छा हो खो करो

verses.sloka: गमिष्याम्यहमेकाकी तिष्ठत्विह बलं मम।अद्य तान् क्षुभितान् क्रुद्धो भक्षयिष्यामि वानरान्।कुम्भकर्णवचः श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६५.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: gamiṣyāmyahamekākī tiṣṭhatviha balaṁ mama।adya tān kṣubhitān kruddho bhakṣayiṣyāmi vānarān।kumbhakarṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.65.22 ।।

translations.english: Hearing Kumbhakarna's words Ravana said," Go with trident, sword and iron bar in hand surrounded by the army."
translations.hindi: हे अतुल विक्रमी ! समरभूमि में अन्य झिसी को भेजने की आवश्यकता नहीं हैं । क्योंकि में अकेला ही तुम्हारे बलवान शत्रु को मार डालूँगा

verses.sloka: सैन्यैः परिवृतो गच्छ शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः।वानरा हि महात्मानः शीघ्राः सुव्यवसायिनः ।। ६.६५.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sainyaiḥ parivṛto gaccha śūlamudgarapāṇibhiḥ।vānarā hi mahātmānaḥ śīghrāḥ suvyavasāyinaḥ ।। 6.65.23 ।।

translations.english: "The Vanaras are gigantic, endowed with speed and determination. They will destroy with their teeth when you are not alert and alone."
translations.hindi: हे कुम्भकर्ण ! देख में तेरा ब्येष्ठ त्राता आचाय के तुल्य मान्य हूँ । तू मुझे क्या सिखलाता है? क्यों तू घोलने का इतना श्रम उठाता है। इस समय तो समयानुरूप काय करना चाहिए

verses.sloka: एकाकिनं प्रमत्तं वा नयेयुर्दशनैः क्षयम्।तस्मात् परमदुर्धर्षैः सैन्यैः परिवृतो व्रज।रक्षसामहितं सर्वं शत्रुपक्षं निषूदय ।। ६.६५.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ekākinaṁ pramattaṁ vā nayeyurdaśanaiḥ kṣayam।tasmāt paramadurdharṣaiḥ sainyaiḥ parivṛto vraja।rakṣasāmahitaṁ sarvaṁ śatrupakṣaṁ niṣūdaya ।। 6.65.24 ।।

translations.english: "Therefore, go surrounded by the army. They are extremely difficult to encounter. They are like thunderbolts. Destroy them who are on the enemy side and not favourable to Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: अब तो इस समय जो करना उचित है, उसे करो | जो बात बीत गई बह तो बीत ही गई । उसके लिए पछताना व्यथ है

verses.sloka: अथासनात् समुत्पत्य स्रजं मणिकृतान्तराम्।आबबन्ध महातेजाः कुम्भकर्णस्य रावणः ।। ६.६५.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāsanāt samutpatya srajaṁ maṇikṛtāntarām।ābabandha mahātejāḥ kumbhakarṇasya rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.65.25 ।।

translations.english: And then the brilliant Ravana got up from his seat, garlanded Kumbhakarna with garland s of flowers encrusted with gems.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदान्यङ्गुलीवेष्टान् वराण्याभरणानि च।हारं च शशिसङ्काशमाबबन्ध महात्मनः ।। ६.६५.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadānyaṅgulīveṣṭān varāṇyābharaṇāni ca।hāraṁ ca śaśisaṅkāśamābabandha mahātmanaḥ ।। 6.65.26 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana placed armlets, rings, exquisite ornaments, garland s of pearls like moonlight on Kumbhakarna's neck.
translations.hindi: हे कुस्भकणे ! यदि मेरे ऊपर तुम्हारा प्रेम है और तुम्हें अपने पराक्रमका भरोस्ता हे और यदि मेरा यह कार्य तुम्हें आवश्यक जान पड़े तो मुझसे जो भूल बन पड़ी है, उसे तुम सम्हाल लो । देखो हितैषी मित्र बद्दी है जो दुखिया पर दया करे ओर भाई बही है जो कुमार्गगामी बन्धु की भी सहायता करे। रावण के इन घोर और निष्ठुर बचनों को

verses.sloka: दिव्यानि च सुगन्धीनि माल्यदामानि रावणः।श्रोत्रे चासञ्जयामास श्रीमती चास्य कुण्डले ।। ६.६५.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: divyāni ca sugandhīni mālyadāmāni rāvaṇaḥ।śrotre cāsañjayāmāsa śrīmatī cāsya kuṇḍale ।। 6.65.27 ।।

translations.english: Ravana then placed his crown, wonderful fragrant garlands and rich suspended earrings on Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: काञ्चनाङ्गदकेयूरनिष्काभरणभूषितः।कुम्भकर्णो बृहत्कर्णः सुहुतो ऽग्निरिवाबभौ ।। ६.६५.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadakeyūraniṣkābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ।kumbhakarṇo bṛhatkarṇaḥ suhuto 'gnirivābabhau ।। 6.65.28 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with armlets studded with gems and golden ornaments on his distinguished large ears, Kumbhakarna shone like fire.

verses.sloka: श्रोणीसूत्रेण महता मेचकेन व्यराजत।अमृतोत्पादने नद्धो भुजङ्गेनेव मन्दरः ।। ६.६५.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: śroṇīsūtreṇa mahatā mecakena vyarājata।amṛtotpādane naddho bhujaṅgeneva mandaraḥ ।। 6.65.29 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with a huge dark girdle, Kumbhakarna seemed like a bright jewel like Mount Mandara used for churning nectar of immortality fastened by Vasuki.

verses.sloka: स काञ्चनं भारसहं निवातं विद्युत्प्रभं दीप्तमिवात्मभासा।आभध्यमानः कवचं रराज सन्ध्याभ्रसंवीत इवाद्रिराजः ।। ६.६५.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa kāñcanaṁ bhārasahaṁ nivātaṁ vidyutprabhaṁ dīptamivātmabhāsā।ābhadhyamānaḥ kavacaṁ rarāja sandhyābhrasaṁvīta ivādrirājaḥ ।। 6.65.30 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna decked in heavy golden shield (impenetrable by any weapon) and difficult to break, seemed like the lightning with self effulgence, glowing like fire, shone like the evening twilight around the mountain peak.
translations.hindi: तब छुम्भकर्ण ने रावण को धीरज बँधाते हुए धीरे से ऋहा-- हे राक्षस ! इस समय अब इस प्रकार सन्तप्त होने की आवश्यकता नहीं है

verses.sloka: सर्वाभरणसर्वाङ्गः शूलपाणिः स राक्षसः।त्रिविक्रमकृतोत्साहो नारायण इवाबभौ ।। ६.६५.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvābharaṇasarvāṅgaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ sa rākṣasaḥ।trivikramakṛtotsāho nārāyaṇa ivābabhau ।। 6.65.31 ।।

translations.english: Decked with ornaments on all his limbs, with pike in hand, the Rakshasa was like Narayana ready to take three strides to cover the universe. Endowed with great strength, embraced his brother, went round in reverence bowing down his head and sallied forth.
translations.hindi: अब तुम क्रोध को शान्त कर स्वस्थ हो जाओ | ह्वे राजम्‌! सेरे जीते तुमको अपने समन“मै कभी ऐसा विचार न लाना चाहिये

verses.sloka: भ्रातरं सम्परिष्वज्य कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्।प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्मै सम्प्रतस्थे महाबलः ।। ६.६५.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātaraṁ sampariṣvajya kṛtvā cābhipradakṣiṇam।praṇamya śirasā tasmai sampratasthe mahābalaḥ ।। 6.65.32 ।।

translations.english: Decked with ornaments on all his limbs, with pike in hand, the Rakshasa was like Narayana ready to take three strides to cover the universe. Endowed with great strength, embraced his brother, went round in reverence bowing down his head and sallied forth.

verses.sloka: निष्पतन्तं महाकायं महानादं महाबलम्।तमाशीर्भिः प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास रावणः ।। ६.६५.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: niṣpatantaṁ mahākāyaṁ mahānādaṁ mahābalam।tamāśīrbhiḥ praśastābhiḥ preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.65.33 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, of huge body, of loud voice and highly capable having been dismissed by Ravana, went with the great army after benediction and started observing.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌! इसीसे में ने बन्धुमाव आर आठस्नेह से प्रेरित हो वे सब बातें तुमसे कहीं। इस समय एक हितैषी भाई का जो कत्तव्य हे वह में करू गा

verses.sloka: शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः सैन्यैश्चापि वरायुधैः।तं गजैश्च तुरङ्गैश्च स्यन्दनैश्चाम्बुदस्वनैः ।। ६.६५.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ sainyaiścāpi varāyudhaiḥ।taṁ gajaiśca turaṅgaiśca syandanaiścāmbudasvanaiḥ ।। 6.65.34 ।।

translations.english: Many great warriors seated on the best of chariots, with best of weapons amidst noise of conchs and drums, elephants, horses also and thunder like chariot warriors, started to proceed.
translations.hindi: तुम देखना कि, आज में रणक्षेत्र में तुम्हारे शत्रुओं का कैसा नाश करता हूँ । हे महाबाहो ! आज जब में युद्धभूमि में लक्ष्मण सहित राम को मार डालूंगा, तब तुम देखना वानरो सेना कैसी भागती है। आज तुम मेरा लाया हुआ राम का कटा सिर देख कर

verses.sloka: अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं रथिनो रथिनां वरम् ।। ६.६५.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: anujagmurmahātmānaṁ rathino rathināṁ varam ।। 6.65.35 ।।

translations.english: On dreadful and mighty serpents, camels, donkeys, horses, lions, antelopes, and birds also the Rakshasas accompanied Kumbhakarna.

verses.sloka: सर्पैरुष्ट्रैः खरैरश्वैः सिंहद्विपमृगद्विजैः।अनुजग्मुश्च तं घोरं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६५.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarpairuṣṭraiḥ kharairaśvaiḥ siṁhadvipamṛgadvijaiḥ।anujagmuśca taṁ ghoraṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.65.36 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna, the enemy of Devas and Danavas determined and eager showered with a rain of flowers, head covered with parasol, excited with drink, wielding sharpened tridents in hand and smeared with blood red fragrant sandal paste, sallied forth in that state.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! तुम हर्षित होना और सीता दुःखी हो । राक्षसों को राम का नांश बड़ा प्रिय है, बे आज़ उसको देखे । लङ्कावासी जो समस्त राक्षस अपने बन्छु वान्धवों के मारे जाने से दुःखी ह रहे को. से उनके दुःख के आलू शत्र, का, युद्ध में विनाश कर पेछू गा । आज पर्वेताकार और सूयंयुङ्त मेघ के समान

verses.sloka: स पुष्पवर्षैरवकीर्यमाणो धृतातपत्रः शितशूलपाणिः।मदोत्कटः शोणितगन्धमत्तो विनिर्ययौ दानवदेवशत्रुः ।। ६.६५.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa puṣpavarṣairavakīryamāṇo dhṛtātapatraḥ śitaśūlapāṇiḥ।madotkaṭaḥ śoṇitagandhamatto viniryayau dānavadevaśatruḥ ।। 6.65.37 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas of loud voice, great prowess, and fearful with frightening eyes, lifted the many weapons in hand and followed on foot.

verses.sloka: पदातयश्च बहवो महानादा महाबलाः।अन्वयू राक्षसा भीमा भीमाक्षाः शस्त्रपाणयः ।। ६.६५.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: padātayaśca bahavo mahānādā mahābalāḥ।anvayū rākṣasā bhīmā bhīmākṣāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ।। 6.65.38 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas with blood red eyes, of huge body size, dark blue in colour, holding tridents, sharpened whetted axes and weapons of many kinds, iron bars and maces, clubs, mallets and palmyra trees, the evil minded vast army set out.

verses.sloka: रक्ताक्षाः सुमहाकाया नीलाञ्जनचयोपमाः।शूलानुद्यम्य खड्गांश्च निशितांश्च परश्वधान् ।। ६.६५.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: raktākṣāḥ sumahākāyā nīlāñjanacayopamāḥ।śūlānudyamya khaḍgāṁśca niśitāṁśca paraśvadhān ।। 6.65.39 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas with blood red eyes, of huge body size, dark blue in colour, holding tridents, sharpened whetted axes and weapons of many kinds, iron bars and maces, clubs, mallets and palmyra trees, the evil minded vast army set out.

verses.sloka: बहुव्यामांश्च परिघान् गदाश्च मुसलानि च।तालस्कन्धांश्च विपुलान् क्षेपणीयान् दुरासदान् ।। ६.६५.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: bahuvyāmāṁśca parighān gadāśca musalāni ca।tālaskandhāṁśca vipulān kṣepaṇīyān durāsadān ।। 6.65.40 ।।

translations.english: Assuming another fearful form, Kumbhakarna who was highly energetic, endowed with mighty strength and frightful in form, which was a hundred bows in breadth and six hundred bows in height, with eyes like wheels of chariot, enraged, seemed like a huge mountain.
translations.hindi: र।क्षसों का बघ करते काले हनुमान को जिसने लङ्का जलाई थी तथा भ्न्य्र सपस्स बावरा झो भ! जो लड़ने आए हैँ-में मार डालू गा

verses.sloka: अथान्यद्वपुरादाय दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्।निष्पपात महातेजाः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।। ६.६५.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: athānyadvapurādāya dāruṇaṁ romaharṣaṇam।niṣpapāta mahātejāḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।। 6.65.41 ।।

translations.english: Assuming another fearful form, Kumbhakarna who was highly energetic, endowed with mighty strength and frightful in form, which was a hundred bows in breadth and six hundred bows in height, with eyes like wheels of chariot, enraged, seemed like a huge mountain.
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसराज ! सो में तो अपने मत में जरा भी सन्तप्त नहीं होता, तब तुम क्यों दुखी होते हं] । हे परन्तप ! इस समय तुम जो चाहते हो सो बतलाओ या तदनुसार आज्ञा दा

verses.sloka: धनुश्शतपरीणाहः स षट्छतसमुच्छ्रितः।रौद्रः शकटचक्राक्षो महापर्वतसन्निभः ।। ६.६५.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhanuśśataparīṇāhaḥ sa ṣaṭchatasamucchritaḥ।raudraḥ śakaṭacakrākṣo mahāparvatasannibhaḥ ।। 6.65.42 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke, Kumbhakarna who resembled a charred mountain, with wide mouth, reaching near the Rakshasas, laughing.

verses.sloka: सन्निपत्य च रक्षांसि दग्धशैलोपमो महान्।कुम्भकर्णो महावक्त्रः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६५.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sannipatya ca rakṣāṁsi dagdhaśailopamo mahān।kumbhakarṇo mahāvaktraḥ prahasannidamabravīt ।। 6.65.43 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, furious Kumbhakarna said "Now I will consume all the battalions of Vanaras just as moths are consumed by fire."

verses.sloka: अद्य वानरमुख्यानां तानि यूथानि भागशः।निर्दहिष्यामि सङ्क्रुद्धः शलभानिव पावकः ।। ६.६५.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya vānaramukhyānāṁ tāni yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ।nirdahiṣyāmi saṅkruddhaḥ śalabhāniva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.65.44 ।।

translations.english: "These forest rangers have never desired to do any harm to me. This clan serve as ornaments of our gardens."
translations.hindi: जब में पैना त्रिशूल हाथ में ले, अपने प्रवेताकार शरीर से, पेने पैने दाँत दिखलाता हुआ गजू गा, तब इन मनुष्यों की तो - बिसाँत ही क्या; इन्द्र भी भयभीत हो जाँयगे

verses.sloka: नापराध्यन्ति मे कामं वानरा वनचारिणः।जातिरस्माद्विधानां सा पुरोद्यानविभूषणम् ।। ६.६५.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nāparādhyanti me kāmaṁ vānarā vanacāriṇaḥ।jātirasmādvidhānāṁ sā purodyānavibhūṣaṇam ।। 6.65.45 ।।

translations.english: "The root cause of besieging Lanka is Rama and Lakshmana. I will kill them in combat."
translations.hindi: अथवा मैं अंखत्यान खाली हाथ भी शत्र ओं को रा प्रो को कचलने लगू तो जिसे जीने की साध होगी, वह कभी रे सार - आवेगा

verses.sloka: पुररोधस्य मूलं तु राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः।हते तस्मिन् हतं सर्वं तं वधिष्यामि संयुगे ।। ६.६५.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: purarodhasya mūlaṁ tu rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ।hate tasmin hataṁ sarvaṁ taṁ vadhiṣyāmi saṁyuge ।। 6.65.46 ।।

translations.english: When Kumbhakarna had spoken that way the Rakshasas made noise that was like the sound of an agitated ocean.
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसराज ! सुके न तो शक्ति की, न गदा की, न पैनी तलवार की आर न पैनेदीर की ही आवश्यकता है। में ता अपने दोनों हाथों ही से क्रद्ध होने पर, यदि इन्द्र भी हो तो उसको भी सार डालूगा

verses.sloka: एवं तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य राक्षसाः।नादं चक्रुर्महाघोरं कम्पयन्त इवार्णवम् ।। ६.६५.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ tasya bruvāṇasya kumbhakarṇasya rākṣasāḥ।nādaṁ cakrurmahāghoraṁ kampayanta ivārṇavam ।। 6.65.47 ।।

translations.english: As wise Kumbhakarna was proceeding swiftly , dreadful portents appeared.

verses.sloka: तस्य निष्पततस्तूर्णं कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः।बभूवुर्घोररूपाणि निमित्तानि समन्ततः ।। ६.६५.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya niṣpatatastūrṇaṁ kumbhakarṇasya dhīmataḥ।babhūvurghorarūpāṇi nimittāni samantataḥ ।। 6.65.48 ।।

translations.english: The clouds appeared in the colour of donkey and there was thunder and lightning. The oceans, forests and earth seemed as though shaken.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌! मेरे रहते तुम क्यों खिन्तिव होते हो ! में तुम्दारे शत्रु का नाश करने के लिए समरभूमि से जाने को तेयार हूँ

verses.sloka: उल्काशनियुता मेघा बभूवुर्गर्दभारुणाः।ससागरवना चैव वसुधा समकम्पत ।। ६.६५.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ulkāśaniyutā meghā babhūvurgardabhāruṇāḥ।sasāgaravanā caiva vasudhā samakampata ।। 6.65.49 ।।

translations.english: She jackals were seen with flaming morsels throwing from their mouths. Birds wheeled in a circular way and settled.

verses.sloka: घोररूपाः शिवा नेदुः सज्वालकवलैर्मुखैः।मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि बबन्धुश्च विहङ्गमाः ।। ६.६५.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: ghorarūpāḥ śivā neduḥ sajvālakavalairmukhaiḥ।maṇḍalānyapasavyāni babandhuśca vihaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.65.50 ।।

translations.english: On the way as he was going an eagle alighted on his pike. His eyes twitched and left shoulder throbbed.

verses.sloka: निष्पपात च मालेव गृध्रो ऽस्य पथि गच्छतः।प्रास्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यो बाहुश्च कम्पते ।। ६.६५.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: niṣpapāta ca māleva gṛdhro 'sya pathi gacchataḥ।prāsphurannayanaṁ cāsya savyo bāhuśca kampate ।। 6.65.51 ।।

translations.english: Then a burning meteor fell from the sky making a terrible sound. The sun lost his glow and the wind lost its delight।।
translations.hindi: SC ७४ से तुम्हारे लिए असाधारण बड़ा यश सम्पादन करूगा |. यदि तुमको इनसे या ब्रह्मा से भी भय हुआ, तो मैं उनको भी मार डालूगा

verses.sloka: निपपात तदा चोल्का ज्वलन्ती भीमनिस्वना।आदित्यो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्न प्रवाति सुखो ऽनिलः ।। ६.६५.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: nipapāta tadā colkā jvalantī bhīmanisvanā।ādityo niṣprabhaścāsīnna pravāti sukho 'nilaḥ ।। 6.65.52 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna went unmindful of the portents which made hair stand on end propelled by the force of destiny.
translations.hindi: में जब कुद्ध हो जाऊंगा, तब देवता भूमि पर लोटते हुए देख पड़ेंगे । में यम को शान्त कर दूंगा और अग्नि को खा डालू गा

verses.sloka: अचिन्तयन् महोत्पातानुत्थितान् रोमहर्षणान्।निर्ययौ कुम्भकर्णस्तु कृतान्तबलचोदितः ।। ६.६५.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: acintayan mahotpātānutthitān romaharṣaṇān।niryayau kumbhakarṇastu kṛtāntabalacoditaḥ ।। 6.65.53 ।।

translations.english: He who resembled a mountain in form, leapt the boundary wall on foot like a cloud and witnessed the amazing Vanara troops.

verses.sloka: स लङ्घयित्वा प्राकारं पद्भ्यां पर्वतसन्निभः।ददर्शाभ्रघनप्रख्यं वानरानीकमद्भुतम् ।। ६.६५.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa laṅghayitvā prākāraṁ padbhyāṁ parvatasannibhaḥ।dadarśābhraghanaprakhyaṁ vānarānīkamadbhutam ।। 6.65.54 ।।

translations.english: On seeing the mountain like form of the foremost of the Rakshasas. the vanaras dispersed in all directions like clouds swept by the wind.
translations.hindi: पहाड़ों के डकड़े टुकड़े कर डालूँगा, प्रथिवी को विदीश कर डाल गा। बहुत दिगा से सोते हुए कुम्भकर्ण का पराक्रम

verses.sloka: ते दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं वानराः पर्वतोपमम्।वायुनुन्ना इव घना ययुः सर्वा दिशस्तदा ।। ६.६५.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ vānarāḥ parvatopamam।vāyununnā iva ghanā yayuḥ sarvā diśastadā ।। 6.65.55 ।।

translations.english: Heavy cloud like Kumbhakarna, a notorious one, perceiving the Vanara troops scattered like clouds in all directions emitted roar, laughing aloud.

verses.sloka: तद्वानरानीकमतिप्रचण्डं दिशो द्रवद्भिन्नमिवाभ्रजालम्।स कुम्भकर्णः समवेक्ष्य हर्षान्ननाद भूयो घनवद् घनाभः ।। ६.६५.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadvānarānīkamatipracaṇḍaṁ diśo dravadbhinnamivābhrajālam।sa kumbhakarṇaḥ samavekṣya harṣānnanāda bhūyo ghanavad ghanābhaḥ ।। 6.65.56 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the dreadful roar of Kumbhakarna, that resembled the rumbling of clouds, many Vanaras fell on the ground like severed Sala trees.

verses.sloka: ते तस्य घोरं निनदं निशम्य यथा निनादं दिवि वारिदस्य।पेतुर्धरण्यां बहवः प्लवङ्गा निकृत्तमूला इव सालवृक्षाः ।। ६.६५.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tasya ghoraṁ ninadaṁ niśamya yathā ninādaṁ divi vāridasya।peturdharaṇyāṁ bahavaḥ plavaṅgā nikṛttamūlā iva sālavṛkṣāḥ ।। 6.65.57 ।।

translations.english: Armed with a huge iron bar, Kumbhakarna stood for destroying the enemies like the great time spirit, deadly God of Death waits at the end of the universe along with Kinkaras, like a king. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चाषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: विपुलपरिघवान् स कुम्भकर्णो रिपुनिधनाय विनिस्सृतो महात्मा।कपिगणभयमाददत् सुभीमं प्रभुरिव किङ्करदण्डवान् युगान्ते ।। ६.६५.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vipulaparighavān sa kumbhakarṇo ripunidhanāya vinissṛto mahātmā।kapigaṇabhayamādadat subhīmaṁ prabhuriva kiṅkaradaṇḍavān yugānte ।। 6.65.58 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। ६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe pañcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 65 ।।
